questions.question:
Which of the option figure will replace the question mark (?) to continue the figure series given below?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eae9a038c0101e00b6e4aa1c7b7f393d809d7d052d71cfbc252464d255db4ed2.png]
questions.solution:
The option figure that will replace the question mark (?) to continue the figure series given below is option ‘1’.

In 1st and 2ⁿd figure, the triangle’s appear as mirror image, same in 2ⁿd and 3rd figure, square appear as mirror image, so in 4th figure, the image of circle will appear as mirror image.

This is possible in all options except ‘4’, so it is eliminated.

Again, the circle in the 1st image is shifted to centre in the 2ⁿd image, again, the kite in the 2ⁿd image is shifted to centre in the 3rd image, so the pentagon in 3rd image will be shifted to centre in the 4th image, i.e, the image that will follow the series.

Only option ‘1’ and ‘3’ has pentagon at its centre. So, we eliminate option ‘2’ here.

Now, we can see that the image of pentagon appears two times in option ‘3’, but in the series this kind of pattern is not followed. So, clearly option ‘3’ is eliminated.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ae9b41bdf58ee25e59860ce5556e31d188b87c11ebaad930591fac0f1d0b6fc9.png] 

Hence, option ‘1’ is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the correct alternative to indicate the arrangement of the following words in a logical and meaningful order.

1. Sleeping

2. Alarm Ringing

3. Morning breakfast

4. Setting – up Alarm

5. Awakening
questions.solution:
1. Sleeping

2. Alarm Ringing

3. Morning breakfast

4. Setting – up Alarm

5. Awakening

We first ‘set up alarm’ and then ‘go to sleep’, in the morning when the ‘alarm rings’, we ‘wake up’ and then have ‘morning breakfast’

So, the logical and meaningful order is:

4. Setting – up Alarm → 1. Sleeping → 2. Alarm Ringing → 5. Awakening → 3. Morning

breakfast

Hence, ‘4, 1, 2, 5, 3’ is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Three statements are given followed by four conclusions numbered I, II, III and IV. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some horses are camels.

Some mouses are camels.

All mouse are ants.

**Conclusions:**

I. No horses are ants.

II. Some ants are mouses.

III. Some ants are camels.

IV. No mouse is horse.

options.text: Only Conclusion I and II follows
Only Conclusion II and III follow
Only Conclusion III and IV follow
Only Conclusion I and III follow

questions.solution:
The least possible venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c466f61b635865e0bd635a98503ae68e1930312c23299f77007026cde37b7405.png] 

I. No horses are ants. → False

II. Some ants are mouses → True

III. Some ants are camels. → True

IV. No mouse is horse. → False

Hence, only Conclusion II and III follows.

questions.question: Karaga is one of the oldest and widely celebrated festivals of ________.
questions.solution:
• **Karaga** is one of the oldest and widely celebrated festivals of Indian State **Karnataka.**
 
• **Karaga **is the festival of the **Thigala community** which celebrated in the first month of the Hindu lunar calendar.
 
• Karaga is a folk dance form of **Karnataka**, which is dedicated to the **goddess Draupadi.**
 
• This annual festival celebrates the **feminine power**.

questions.question: Identify the third country in the trilateral naval exercise with India and Singapore that took place in September 2019, along with the place at which the exercise commenced.
questions.solution:
• The Singapore-India-**Thailand **Maritime Exercise (SITMEX) is the maiden trilateral exercise that took place in September 2019.
 
• SITMEX involving the Republic of Singapore Navy (**RSN**), Indian Navy (**IN**) and the Royal Thai Navy (**RTN**).
 
• SITMEX commenced at the **Port Blair, Andaman and Nicobar Islands of India**.
 
• During Shangri La dialogue in June 2018, This trilateral exercise was announced by Indian PM.
 
• This exercise aims to enhance the **maritime security** in the region and boost maritime relationships amongst participating countries.

questions.question: If a particular religious sect or community has been declared a "National Minority", which of the following is NOT an advantage its members can avail?

options.text: Special schemes for enhanced credit support in matters of employment
Setting up of separate institutions only for the members of their Community
Derive benefits from the Prime Minister's 15 point program

questions.solution:
• Minority communities can not set up any separate institute only for** members of their community.**
 
• India has several minority communities: **Muslims, Christians, Sikhs, Buddhists, Jain**.
 
• **Article 30** enables minorities to set up and govern their own educational institutions.
 
• But the institute should be governed by Universal rules and **not only for Minorites**.

questions.question: Which massive movement began after 1930 Dandi March?
questions.solution:

• This movement was led by **Mahatma Gandhi** when the British Government not given any response to his demands.
 
• In March 1930, Mahatma Gandhi began the historic **Dandi march** from **Sabarmati Ashram to Dandi.**
 
• Civil Disobedience Movement involved: **Defiance of salt laws, Boycott of liquor and Non-payment of taxes and revenue.**

questions.question: ______ range is the largest range of the lower Himalayas.

questions.question: Photo receptors of a printer or a photocopy machine is made of which element?
questions.solution:

• The main advantages of this material are the** low deposition temperature**** **that offers the use of glass. 
 
• **Amorphous silicon (a-Si**) photoreceptor drums, which are long-life and highly durable products.

questions.question: Which of the following philosophies of Indian Philosophy (School of Thought) is often called "Indian Materialism"?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Option **3**, i.e **__Lokayat__.**

 
• Lokayat or the Indian Materialistic School focuses on materialism, and things beyond **Supernaturalism**.
 
• For them, the empirical reality is what counts and metaphysical reality is nothing but hogwash.
 
• "Eat, Sleep and Make Merry" is their motto.
 
• Other major India Philosophical Schools focus on metaphysical reality, and on concepts like God, Soul and Metaphysical World beyond the world of humans.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a greenhouse gas?

questions.question: The ratio of monthly incomes of A and B is 3 : 4 and the ratio of their monthly savings is 7 : 6, If the income of A is equal to twice the expenditure of B, then what is the ratio of the expenditures of A and B?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Ratio of monthly income of A and B is 3 : 4

Ratio of monthly savings of A and B is 7 : 6

Income of A = 2 × Expenditure of B

**Concept used:**

Savings = Income - Expenditure

**Calculation:**

Let the monthly incomes of A and B are 3x and 4x

Their monthly savings are 7y and 6y

According to the question

3x = 2 × (4x – 6y)

⇒ 3x = 8x – 12y

⇒ 8x – 3x = 12y

⇒ 5x = 12y

⇒ x : y = 12 : 5

Income of A = 3x = 3 × 12 = 36

Income of B = 4x = 4 × 12 = 48

Savings of A = 7y = 7 × 5 = 35

Savings of B = 6y = 6 × 5 = 30

Expenditure of A = 36 – 35 = 1

Expenditure of B = 48 – 30 = 18

**The ratio of expenditure of A to than that of B is 1 : 18**

questions.question:
**Given below are four jumbled sentences. Pick the option that gives their correct order.**

A. It took us a long time to make the ladder but we finished it before nightfall.

B. We had to fix the ladder to the lower branches of our tree.

C. The ladder was then pulled up and fixed in place.

D. We did this by shooting an arrow, with a rope attached to it, over the branch.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **option 3, i.e.** '__BDCA'.__

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

The sentence, i.e. **B,"We had to fix the ladder to the lower branches of our tree."** is the first sentence as it is introducing a topic.

The next sentence is **D, "We did this by shooting an arrow, with a rope attached to it, over the branch."** because it is giving some information about the action that is mentioned in the previous sentence.

The third sentence is **C, "The ladder was then pulled up and fixed in place."** because it is talking about what was done once the process (which is mentioned in the previous sentence) was finished.

The last sentence is **A, "It took us a long time to make the ladder but we finished it before nightfall."** because it is concluding the entire process.

Hence, **option 3** is the answer.

questions.question:

options.text: His boss ordered him to finished his project soon.

His boss order him to finish his project soon.
His boss has ordered him to finish his project soon.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

The given sentence is in the **Simple past tense.**

The construction of the given sentence in **Passive voice** is:

**Subject + was/were + past participle form of verb + by + agent**

 He was ordered by his boss o finish the project soon.

The **agent** of the **Passive voice** will become the **subject **of the **Active voice **and the **subject** of the **passive voice **will become the object of the **Active voice.**

The construction of the **Active voice** should be:

**Subject + Verb + Object**

His boss ordered him to finish his project soon.

Hence,** option 2** is the answer.

questions.question:

options.text: My professor said to me, "You are selected to represent your college in the debate competition."
My professor said to me, "I am selected to represent our college in the debate competition."
My professor said to me, "You are selected to represent their college in the debate competition."
My professor said to me, "You have been selected to represent our college in the debate competition."

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__My professor said to me, "You are selected to represent our college in the debate competition."__**

**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

The Reporting verb is in the '**Simple past tense**' and the Reported speech is in the '**Simple past tense**'. Therefore, in Direct speech, the tense of the reported speech will be changed into the **'simple present tense'.**

The given sentence:

My professor told me that __I was selected to represent our college in the debate competition.__

**Subject + reporting verb + object + that + reported speech **(simple past tense)

In the direct speech, the reporting verb will change into '**said to'.**

The given sentence will get converted to: 

My professor said to me, "__You are selected to represent our college in the debate competition."__

**Subject + reporting verb + object + ** **reported speech **(simple present tense)

Hence, **option 1 **is the answer.

questions.question:

options.text: The director request the actor to memorise his lines properly.
The director requested the actor to memorise his lines properly.
The director requested the actor to memorise your lines properly.
The director requested the actor memorised his lines properly.

questions.solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in Direct Speech. As per the given question we have to change it into Indirect Speech. 
 
• The process of transformation as follows: 
 
 
• The given sentence is an example of 'Imperative Sentence'. 
 
• The notion of the given sentence is 'request' ('please' is demonstrating it). Therefore, 'Said to' will be changed into 'Requested'. 
 
• Comma and inverted commas will be removed. 
 
• We know that in imperative Indirect transformation 'inverted commas' are removed. Requested is followed by the preposition 'to'.
 
• 'your' will be changed into 'his' according to **'the actor'.**
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2. 

 ​

Thus, the sentence becomes: *The director requested the actor to memorise his lines properly.*
